ops.title: Verify bluebubbles launchctl-disable debloat persistence live
ops.description: Spun out of 2adec76 (metal half fixed via b8dbd24 user/<uid> domain + b11e8d2 boot re-apply). bluebubbles runs the safe-subset cmd_debloat in scripts/bluebubbles-setup.sh — verify on the live guest that its launchctl disable overrides actually persist (bluebubbles HAS an Aqua session, so the metal root cause may not apply; confirm rather than assume).

ops.text: launchctl print-disabled output on the live bluebubbles guest shows the debloat overrides after a reboot
